title: FleetEvidence
description: The read-side FLEET join (plan 051 · T003): N per-session SessionEvidence objects merged into one fleet unit with honest cost/time totals (workshop D2/D3). CLOSED and counts-only (AC-07, Constitution P12): `additionalProperties: false` on every fixed-shape object so a stray/un-enumerated key FAILS validation; the only open maps are count histograms (skills/tools/harness_verbs), whose VALUES are pinned to integers. Carries ids (pij ids, file paths, skill/tool/verb names, roles), counts, and closed enums only — never prose, message text, or free-form strings.

root_pij_id.description: The orchestrator (root pij id) this fleet was joined on.

scope.description: How membership was scoped — env-tree superset, roster-scoped run, or an explicit id list (D1).

sessions.description: One lane per session — orchestrator first (when present), then children by descending cost.

orphans.description: Rostered pij ids with no env-tree match (D1 diff); empty without a roster.

unrostered.description: Env-tree children absent from the roster (D1 diff); empty without a roster.

cost.description: A LOWER BOUND over MEASURED lanes — unmeasured (copilot-null, F-07) lanes are excluded, never zero-filled, and counted loudly (AC-02).

time.description: From OTLP/event timestamps (AC-03). wall_clock = union of lane spans; active = sum; parallelism = active/wall. null when no lane had a span.

segments.description: Total segments merged across all lanes.

pij_id.description: The child's own pij id (captured_env.PIJ_SESSION_ID) — the join key.

role.description: Role from the roster when scoped (coder/reviewer/…), else null.

harness.description: pij harness label (claude | copilot | codex | pi) or the segment harness.

model.description: First model name seen across the lane, or null.

cost_measured.description: false ⇒ a tokens:null (copilot) lane, excluded from totals (never zero-filled).

tokens.description: Per-lane cost (fleet-layer — SessionEvidence carries no tokens). {0,0} on an unmeasured lane.

sessionEvidence.description: The existing per-session evidence object, unchanged (session-evidence.ts) — counts/ids/enums derived from the event stream.

skills.description: skill name → run count (histogram; keys open, values integer counts).
